description: Tests first: encrypted secrets, session/config binding, expiration, one worker, cancellation racing completion, crash and interrupted restart, existing grant preservation and atomic success. Add separate device schema and temporary worker supervision on Engine; reuse shared binding and canonical Mutations. Worker consumes provider instructions; no Oban or recovery. Internal local-only polling is not independently exposed. Public start/status/cancel are domain operations at authenticated/confidential dispatch boundaries. Property-test terminal-state and timing invariants. No network inside Repo transactions.
title: [zaq-p8t.2] Device attempts and temporary worker
